name: ia-project
description: Monorepo for IA Project - Frontend and Backend

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd app-user/app-frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.build:mock: cd app-user/backend && npm run build && cd ../app-frontend && npm run build:mock
scripts.build:dev: cd app-user/backend && npm run build && cd ../app-frontend && npm run build:dev
